kind: engineering integration acceptance only; no pretrained model, old dataset, training quality, compression efficacy or scientific rerun
platform: Windows only; fail closed with complete failure receipts, no Linux or uncontained fallback

cases_in_order.expected: Authenticated interpreter, native cmd child, Torch import and one finite CPU backward/SGD update; declared2/2 threads and raw native thread count recorded; synchronous memory before/after32MiB touched manual allocation agrees; native child released with nonempty done line, all retained exit codes0, job empty.
Same healthy path with64MiB as the no-cap negative control. Both resident/private increase>=56MiB; no memory termination.

Same import/single update and memory baseline; worker performs repeated no_grad CPU matmul without extra backwards/optimizer updates. Parent samples correct retained interpreter during1.5s, observes>=0.25s native process CPU progress and max recorded gap<=0.5s, then terminates job with actual interpreter and native child live immediately before request. All handles exit/job empty within4s.

Private limit=post-import/single-update/preallocated-buffers baseline+48MiB. Held manual64MiB causes crossing, then verified first busy no_grad matmul runs. Parent terminates whole job within1s of allocated self-before receipt, verifies live interpreter/native descendant immediately before action, all exits/job empty within4s. Do not apply cap during Torch import.

Deliberate os._exit(37) before backend/handshake/import/descendant. Parent detects retained launcher exit37 with no handshake, records actual interpreter identity unavailable rather than substitutes launcher, and job empties within4s. Other exit/timeout is failure.

Interpreter and native child authenticated before import gate. Deterministic importlib import of nonce-named missing module raises ModuleNotFoundError, emits authenticated import-failure receipt and exits38, no Torch import/operation. Parent verifies exact failure/exit, terminates any remaining job members and verifies all retained handles exited/job empty. Unrelated failure is not expected success.

launch_and_identity: Explicit frozen venv python.exe -S path. Reuse unchanged WindowsJob suspended/assign/resume, nonce, process handles/creation times, Toolhelp ancestry and live membership. No site/Torch import before authenticated handshake and import release. site.main with user site disabled enables the known local venv packages only after release. Verify actual Torch version and CPU build; no download, GPU or package install.
native_descendant: Worker Popen starts frozen Windows System32/cmd.exe directly with argv /d /q /c and literal set /p workload_observer_gate=, stdin anonymous PIPE, stdout/stderr DEVNULL, close_fds=True, CREATE_NO_WINDOW. Parent verifies native PID from worker against retained native creation time, OS QueryFullProcessImageNameW file hash, direct Toolhelp parent=actual worker and same JobObject. Native cmd has no nonce/self-report: its identity is parent OS evidence plus authenticated worker launch receipt. cmd waits for pipe input without network/files; healthy worker writes nonempty done CRLF then closes pipe/waits exit0. Failure controls hold pipe; whole-job cleanup may include EOF exit after worker termination, no exclusive per-descendant kill-cause claim.
workload: Fixed1024square float32 CPU tensors; constant deterministic input and parameter, one forward squared-mean scalar, one backward and one SGD(lr0.001,momentum0) optimizer step. Record finite loss/gradient/updated parameter and nonzero parameter change. No RNG/model/data, no optimizer/second backward in busy phase. Allocate/touch busy output before post-import baseline; busy uses torch.no_grad matmul into fixed output with10s monotonic backstop. Torch allocator/runtime memory is distinct from manual ctypes payload, whose maximum is64MiB; no GPU calls.
thread_boundary: Set and check actual torch.get_num_threads()==2 and get_num_interop_threads()==2; record raw OS actual-interpreter native thread count before/after operation and busy process CPU. Configured thread settings/raw count/CPU progress do not prove exact concurrent kernel workers, thread ownership or behavior of every native/provider child.
memory_and_sampling: Self-before, parent actual retained-handle read, self-after at post-import/workload-ready baseline and manual-allocation plateau. Check PID/creation/time bracket and resident/private tolerance4MiB. Keep sample timestamps during active busy phases, include busy start/end boundaries in maxgap; maxgap0.5s is a controlled observation gate, not continuous memory/peak. Private cap is sampled threshold termination, permits controlled overshoot, not hard ceiling or arbitrary descendant memory cap. Whole-suite sampled memory does not imply training cost benefit.
freeze_execution_and_failure: Root reviews protocol/code/unit mocks and exact source/dependency/Python/cmd hashes; writes implementation freeze before one real suite into a fresh directory. Subagent performs only pure mock tests. All6cases retained in fixed order; no retry/replacement/threshold tuning after results. Each deadline is min(stage,case20s,suite120s); cleanup gets at most4s and fits remaining total budget. Expected negative controls pass only with their precise expected failure and cleanup; all unrelated exceptions remain failed gates. No historical frozen files/ledger/docs modified.
reporting: Full nonce-bound worker identity and native OS evidence, import/operation/thread traces, self/parent brackets, sampled intervals/maxgaps/native CPU delta, exact expected-vs-observed reason, exit/termination request/return/cleanup times, all failures and hashes. Publish basename/hash of local executables, suppress local absolute paths. Engineering acceptance does not fix historical observer measurements or clear H1 quality/efficiency/production gates.
